# Lunova Services

> House cleaning and mobile auto detailing across the Kansas City metro, with trash
> bin cleaning as an add-on. Locally owned and owner-operated, serving both sides of
> the state line. Phone: (816) 315-1305

Lunova Services is a service-area business with no storefront — crews travel to the
customer. Prices shown on the site are flat-rate floors confirmed by phone before any
work begins. Bookings are taken online or by phone; nothing is charged at booking.

## Services

- [Residential Cleaning](https://www.lunovaservices.com/services/residential-cleaning)
- [Auto Detailing](https://www.lunovaservices.com/services/auto-detailing)
- [Bin Cleaning](https://www.lunovaservices.com/services/bin-cleaning)

## Guides

- [The move-out cleaning checklist that gets your deposit back](https://www.lunovaservices.com/guides/move-out-cleaning-checklist): Room by room, what a landlord inspects, what they can legally deduct, and where the money actually goes missing.
- [Is trash bin cleaning actually worth paying for?](https://www.lunovaservices.com/guides/trash-bin-cleaning-worth-it): What the wash really removes, what it costs per year, and when you should just do it yourself with a hose.
- [What house cleaning costs in Kansas City](https://www.lunovaservices.com/guides/house-cleaning-cost-kansas-city): Real 2026 numbers for the metro, what moves the price, and the quote patterns worth walking away from.
- [What mobile detailing actually costs in Kansas City](https://www.lunovaservices.com/guides/mobile-detailing-cost-kansas-city): The real price ranges in this metro, what each tier includes, and the three jobs where paying more changes nothing.
